basis: RFC 8259 section 6 interoperability guidance for numeric magnitude and precision
normative_requirement: A CWL provider-neutral JSON event MUST preserve ordinary JSON booleans and exact interoperable integers, and MUST reject integer values outside [-(2**53)+1, (2**53)-1] unless a higher-level contract explicitly represents the value using a non-numeric typed encoding.
profile_notes: This profile protects exact cross-language value identity at the shared interchange boundary; it does not require domain schemas to stringify ordinary integers.
Higher-level contracts may define explicit decimal, big-integer, or string encodings when values outside the exact interoperable JSON number range are semantically required.
